DeepSeek Harness 自媒体工作台插件：一句话记灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜
description.zh: 一句话记下灵感，自动生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜，自媒体创作全流程一站搞定。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Offers unlimited long-term memory for AI assistants, enabling context retention across sessions and tasks.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
description.zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

description.en: The desktop app has its own refresh button. Edited a plugin but a run is still going? Refresh. Window sluggish after hours of use? Refresh. One button fixes both — running sessions, queued messages and drafts are untouched.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端自己的刷新按钮。开发插件要重启，可手里还有任务在跑？刷新一下！开久了页面越来越卡？刷新一下！一个按钮解决这些烦恼，正在进行的会话、排队消息和草稿都不受影响。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat

In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
description.zh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：插件发现、安装、升级、开关与卸载一站完成，跟随 Web / Desktop 宿主 profile；4,000+ 条社区目录搭配可自定义精选清单，附 8 个 agent 工具与独立 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或账号。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer). v0.19 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.19.2 or newer (0.19.5 is latest). Settings, dashboard and composer chip keep working on both the legacy and the rc.2 host APIs.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。v0.16 把记忆图谱升级为可交互 3D 球面（Canvas 手绘、零依赖）：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、拖节点 3D 整理布局、双击空白重置、自动慢转（尊重减少动态效果）；悬停或点击节点即时高亮邻居（位移+时长点击阈值），配色随浅色/深色面板自适应。v0.17 新增图谱搜索（排序匹配，镜头飞到命中的节点并点亮邻居）、节点的「在 Finder 中显示 / 复制路径」（等待命令结果，失败自动复制路径兜底）、Windows 兼容（路径变量展开、CRLF 读写保留换行风格、explorer 参数与退出码处理、工作区大小写匹配），README 精简并加入真实截图。v0.18（issue #8）新增 boot 快照模式：session 在本会话固化 boot 块，会话中途写记忆不再让前缀缓存失效（最近动态改走独立的靠后 context 段），默认仍是 live；双击记忆节点改为在 DSH 右侧栏打开该文件（打不开时回退系统文件管理器）。v0.19 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.19.2 或更新版本（最新 0.19.5）。设置面板、看板与输入框 chip 在老宿主与 rc.2 上均可工作。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: DSH 壁纸引擎：本机 WE 壁纸实时渲染，视频/网页/开机动画/桌宠皮肤，一键拉取在线素材。

Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Task ledger: a dsh plugin that has the agent create, claim, advance and close tasks, writing each step straight into a plain-text ledger in the workspace so the owner, the current state and the next step stay on record; no cloud service is involved, single-user and multi-user both work with Git synchronisation, and a control panel summarises in-flight, overdue and stalled work with weekly trends.
description.zh: 任务台账：任务由代理创建、认领、推进与结案，每一步直接写入工作区内的纯文本台账，使负责人、当前状态与下一步全程留痕；不涉及云服务，单人多人皆可用、以 Git 同步，看板汇总进行中、逾期与停滞的任务与每周趋势。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
description.zh: 不另开窗口：用右栏内置浏览器，同一份 cookie、同一处登录，指针走到哪点到哪。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Hosts QQ chats as DeepSeek Harness sessions: one QQ conversation maps to one DSH session that survives restarts, per-speaker tool permissions, three-layer memory with nightly consolidation, optional QQ-number binding that ties openids to QQ numbers so memories survive a bot or AppID change (binding is voluntary, never required, and never guessed from nicknames), four-section personas, context compaction, a ten-page sidebar panel, and a setup wizard that installs the Roost kernel and ai-chat plugin. Anyone in a paired QQ group can chat with the bot by default; only the owner gets the full local toolset.
description.zh: 把 QQ 会话接进 DeepSeek Harness：一个 QQ 会话对应一个 DSH 会话、重启后映射保留，按说话人分档收放本地工具，三层记忆（事实 / 日记 / 图谱）+ 凌晨巩固，可选的 QQ 号绑定把 openid 对上 QQ 号 / 群号，换机器人（换 AppID）后旧记忆照样读得到（绑定完全自愿、非必需，昵称候选只提示不自动绑），人格四段式，上下文压缩，侧栏十页面板，接入向导会自动装好 Roost 内核与 ai-chat 插件。接好的 QQ 群里任何人都能和机器人聊天；只有主人拿得到完整的本地工具。

description.en: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

description.en: Manages client-side plugins for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to install, enable, or remove extensions easily.
description.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness客户端插件，支持用户轻松安装、启用或移除扩展。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Archives, stores, and organizes entire sessions for later retrieval, ensuring conversation history is preserved and accessible.
description.zh: 归档并存储整个会话，便于日后检索，确保对话历史得以保存和访问。

description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。

description.en: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
description.zh: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

description.en: Provides internationalization utilities for the DeepSeek Harness web plugin ecosystem, supporting translations across the workshop.
description.zh: 为插件生态提供国际化与翻译支持，方便多语言界面开发。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到 DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输，用 slash 命令管理会话、工作区、模型、权限等等，目标是在微信端还原 DSH 的原生体验。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Fixes plugins a DSH upgrade left behind: rehearse each rejected plugin in a throwaway home, grant a reversible exact-version exemption when it boots, and refuse when it does not. Also a multi-host compatibility matrix, a public table of every catalogued plugin, and a read-only plugin_health tool.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 升级后被落下的插件：每个被拒绝的插件先在一次性环境里试装试启动，能启动才写一条可撤销的精确版本豁免，不能启动就明确拒绝。另有：多宿主兼容矩阵、覆盖全部已收录插件的公开兼容表，以及只读的 plugin_health 工具。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.
Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Provides a Codex-style interface for interacting with DeepSeek Harness, enhancing the user experience.
description.zh: 用Codex的方式打开deepseek-harness

description.en: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。

description.en: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.
description.zh: 别的记忆插件让 AI 记住更多，我们让 AI 只记住对的：Agent 只能提案，人工审核才进主库（三库分离 + 不可变审计日志）；召回走 SQLite FTS5/BM25、零模型调用（实测 p50 2.3ms），记忆账本摊开召回成本与有用率。一个库接 DSH / Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / MengBot（任意 MCP 客户端）；v0.31 起内置五套一键切换皮肤（默认暗色 / 波普 / 明亮 / 生化危机 / 蜘蛛侠）与全幅主题头图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型、同样的思考强度，只花更少的输出 token，全程提示词侧。默认只开「精简输出」（late 模式，第 4 步后生效），其余开关默认关、可单独打开；工具输出很长时再开「截短工具输出」那个。本机实测、非榜单成绩：输出偏长的 30 对任务，只开截短开关时 0.756× 耗时、输出 token −21%；6 个真实 `pallets/click` PR 共 24 对，0.805× 耗时、token −23%。在官方 SWE-bench Lite 题目定义上用自建 harness 量不出收益（8 题、三次独立跑合池 72 对：墙钟 0.933×、token 0.903×，墙钟仍跨 1；同一配置单跑之间就差三成），往截短上再叠别的开关反而更差。数字与复现见仓库。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: 2-4 real Chats you rearrange entirely from the keyboard, save as named layouts, and jump through by which pane needs you.
description.zh: 把 2 到 4 个真实对话并排放在一个窗口里，每个窗格都是完整聊天界面，方便对比和同时干活。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree, Git panel (commit graph, push/pull, per-file revert), SSH hosts and a real PTY terminal on the left, while the official DSH conversation stays docked on the right so tool calls, file edits, approvals and session history keep working as you code. Built on a craft-first belief: write it by hand, understand every change, treat AI as an assistant and stay the first owner of your software.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 IDE 模式：点工作区「…」菜单一键把主面板变成 VS Code 风格工作台——左侧 Monaco 编辑器、文件树、Git 面板（提交图/推送/拉取/逐文件还原）、SSH 主机与真实 PTY 终端，右侧原样停靠官方 DSH 会话，写代码时工具调用、自动改文件、审批与会话历史照常可用。作者主张「古法编程」：亲手写、每个改动心中有数，AI 是助理，你是软件的第一责任人。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
description.zh: 给插件作者用：写完插件后跑一遍，自动体检整条发布链路，然后给出 GitHub + npm + 市场三步的可照抄命令。 DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM 里调 require()、缺 LICENSE 或 README 安装行、缺测试、裸包名 （granular token 收到无法诊断的 403）、版本已被 registry 占用、GitHub 仓库不存在。六个 agent 工具， 每条 finding 都带修复文案。只读，不调 LLM。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Automatically captures and stores runtime context and project documents for persistent, searchable memory across sessions.
description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.en: Scopes memory capture to specific projects or sessions, enabling targeted and organized long-term recall.
description.zh: 将记忆捕获限定在特定项目或会话内，实现精准且有组织的长期回顾。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-design skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes canvases of artboards as files and opens them in a local canvas editor.

Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and turns selections in the sidebar preview into edit requests for the session. Python 3.10-3.13 required.
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

description.en: One-click polish, expand and autopilot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrite the draft with the model the session is switched to, expand a one-line wish into a task brief without asking questions, or let an AI drive a goal round after round.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一键润色、扩写和自动驾驶，写东西更省心。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-slides skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes editable slide decks as files and opens them in a local slide editor.

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Connects MCP servers, discovers tools and prompts, and manages connections with OAuth, API keys, and JSON import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 MCP连接器、连接管理与扩展市场：连接 MCP Server，发现工具与 Prompt，扩展 AI 技能；支持 OAuth/PKCE、API Key、JSON 导入。由企查查（Qichacha/QCC）团队发起维护。General-purpose MCP connector, connection manager, plugin, extension and integration marketplace.

description.en: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
description.zh: 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能，一键收编进 DSH 用户库；内置 6600+ 技能市场，支持注入开销（≈token）统计与模型可见性治理。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs offline in demo mode with placeholder media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的节点式创作工作室——在无限画布上完成剧本、分镜、参考图与多镜头视频生成，可由对话批量驱动；图像/视频/TTS 需自带服务商（OpenAI 风格接口，或 Seedance/Sora 风格视频 API），未配置时整条流水线以离线演示模式运行、只产出占位素材。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept for 7 days, and controls which agents can see each skill and whether the model may invoke it.
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。

description.en: Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-design-system skill from baoyu-design. The agent writes design systems (tokens, type, components, assets) as files and opens them in a local design-system page.
